# motherduck_guide_grantees (Data Source)

Lists the direct roles or organization configured to read one MotherDuck Guide.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "motherduck_guide_grantees" "revenue" {
  guide_id = "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `guide_id` (String) Guide ID. Must be a UUID with no leading or trailing whitespace.

### Read-Only

- `rows` (Attributes List) Typed catalog rows for stable MotherDuck metadata. `rows_json` remains available for raw server columns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))
- `rows_json` (String, Sensitive) Raw MotherDuck catalog rows encoded as JSON. Sensitive because catalog rows can include share URLs and account metadata.

<a id="nestedatt--rows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rows`

Read-Only:

- `granted_at` (String) Grant creation timestamp.
- `grantee_name` (String) Role or organization name.
- `grantee_type` (String) Grantee type: role or organization.
- `privilege` (String) Granted Guide privilege.
